scientific_integrity: Exact symbolic proof of a necessary-and-sufficient statement. Finite tests check the implementation, not the infinite theorem; comparison with earlier work is best-knowledge and does not constitute independent priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact two-exponential endpoint only; two-state column Markov generators with a common strictly positive total exit rate; not the full nonlinear multi-stage method; no claims for unequal exit rates or larger state spaces. The universal cutoff is not a pointwise cutoff for each pair.
title: Sharp two-state positivity horizon for a commutator-free Magnus endpoint
